segments.caption: The camera pans slowly upward from a stone bridge over a river, revealing the iconic Eiffel Tower rising majestically in the background against a clear sky. In the foreground, two small, colorful kayaks—one red and one green—float calmly on the water, adding a touch of vibrant life to the serene, urban riverside scene.
